description: Electrical parts of machinery or apparatus; not specified or elsewhere included in this chapter

predecessors.note: HS 2022 renumbered 8548.90 to 8548.00 and moved electrical and electronic waste out to heading 85.49, so this code covers less than the old one. The years before 2022 are on the retired code's own page, HS 854890, and are not joined on.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
